none: PAS LEIC-3EBE93: early medieval copper alloy brooch spacer
contea di ritrovamento: Rutland (Inghilterra e Galles)

Early medieval copper alloy spacer plate from a linked pin set. The object is inscribed with runes which appear to spell out [CE]OLBURG, a female name known from late 8th C. The form of the runes and the object type suggest an 8th or 9th century date. This may be the first example of a Runic inscription found in Rutland
